children: Federal prosecutors arrested a California man on Thursday and charged him with smuggling computer servers containing $300 million worth of Nvidia Corp. artificial intelligence chips to China in violation of US export controls, according to Bloomberg.
The case centers on alleged shipments of servers with Nvidia AI chips.

title: US Charges California Man Over $300 Million Nvidia Chip Shipments to China
